title: Device & Distributed Intelligence Runtime
objective: Implement the provider-neutral Device and Distributed Intelligence Runtime in the TypeScript base so inference can run on-device, edge, Local Bridge/Ollama, BYO providers or explicitly entitled Titan-managed providers under privacy, authority, cost and provenance policy.
